newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland opens tender for Gdanski stake.
newsitem.headline: Poland opens tender for Gdanski stake.

text.p: The Polish finance ministry has invited investors to negotiate a purchase of 6,260,240 shares, or a 31.94-percent stake, in Bank Gdanski SA, the ministry said in a statement published in the daily Rzeczpospolita on Monday.
The ministry currently holds 7,322,583 Gdanski shares, nearly 37.34 percent of the bank.
Investors must submit bids for the 31.94-percent stake by January 6, the statement said.
The Bank of New York as a depositary bank currently holds 19.5 percent of Gdanski's shares, represented by 19.5 percent of the bank's GDRs held by foreign investors.
Poland's bank BIG SA and its subsidiaries have about 31 percent of Gdanski shares and small investors on the Warsaw bourse hold the rest.
